mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below historical averages signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A threshold crossing of the unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated unemployment may indicate weakening labor market conditions and reduced growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in the next month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative relationship.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the supply index (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic growth, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing demand (HOUST) exceeding 1250 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days, reflecting accelerated economic activity and investor optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite the trigger, or IC <0.03 over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates compress equity valuations and raise borrowing costs.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of tightening periods despite the signal, or IC >0.03 over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, driving investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite sustained PAYEMS growth, or IC <0.03 over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) indices signals broad-based economic expansion, enhancing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below recent levels signals peak demand, prompting investors to anticipate a slowdown and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of late-cycle instances despite the signal, or IC >0.03 over the 60-day horizon.
